title: Protect shared Tdarr test-library parents
summary: Require Tdarr materialization to target a direct tool-owned child of TestLibraries and use root-bound sentinel identity plus recoverable rebuild quarantine.
reason: Remediate P1 AUDIT-FIND-W11-018. The rebuild containment check accepts the shared TestLibraries parent itself and a same-named sentinel alone authorizes recursive deletion of every child below it.
behavior_before: Any path equal to or below LocalBase/Scratch/TestLibraries passes containment, and --rebuild recursively deletes it when the sentinel filename exists without validating its contents or root ownership.
behavior_after: Materialization accepts only a direct TdarrMatrix* child of the resolved TestLibraries parent, rejects the parent itself and any symlink/junction/reparse component, and requires a parsed sentinel with the expected schema, purpose, exact root path/hash, and nonzero build nonce before rebuild. The owned leaf moves to a sibling quarantine, is restored on failure, and never mutates unrelated sibling libraries.
tests_added: Exact shared-parent and unrelated non-Tdarr child roots are rejected while their sibling files survive.
Malformed, schema-only, and copied root-identity sentinels fail closed without deleting their directories.
A Windows directory junction target is rejected and preserved.
A valid owned-leaf rebuild retains the prior tree in quarantine and preserves unrelated TestLibraries siblings.
A post-quarantine configuration failure restores the prior owned leaf and preserves failed partial output.
manual_validation: Focused materializer boundary suite passed: 9 tests and 2 subtests with no skips.
Adjacent materializer, Tdarr Proof Pack, Policy Proof Pack, matrix audit, and desktop service slice passed: 69 tests and 10 subtests.
Targeted Ruff validation passed for the changed implementation and tests.
Targeted summary freshness, project index/dependency graph, feature map, risky-file registry, git diff --check, and strict worktree coverage passed; strict coverage reported 1,165 valid packets.
rollback_plan: Revert the strict tool-owned leaf boundary, sentinel identity validation, quarantine/rollback behavior, temporary-filesystem tests, generated summaries/maps, and this packet together. Preserve any reported quarantine or failed-partial paths for manual recovery.
notes: High-risk disposable-filesystem validation only. Representative real media is neither required nor allowed; all tests use synthetic temporary fixtures and must prove unrelated sibling preservation.
